entries.title: Usage opens and refreshes without pausing the app
entries.body: Settings → Usage used to add up every model response ever recorded each time it opened or refreshed, which on a long-used record could pause the whole app for a fraction of a second. It now keeps a running total for each day and adds up those instead, so the same figures come back several times faster.
entries.noPicture: Usage shows the same figures as before; only how quickly they are read changes.
